mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 3% signals a tightening monetary regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.0% and remains above for at least one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -2% mean) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 3% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 over two consecutive quarters indicates weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1% mean) following two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 6% signals a tight labor market that boosts wage pressure and input costs, eroding profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE exceeds 6.0% in a single month after being below 5.5% the prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1% mean) after UNRATE spikes above 6% from below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PAYEMS and a decrease in UNRATE over three months indicates robust job creation with stable labor utilization, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises for three consecutive months while UNRATE remains flat or declines
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1% mean) when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE is flat/falling for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals improving industrial production and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12-month moving average for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1% mean) following four months of INDPRO above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST over two months signals weakening housing and overall demand, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate revenues, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -2% mean) when both GDPC1 and HOUST fall for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month drop in FEDFUNDS below 1% during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY) signals an accommodative stance that boosts risk assets, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls by > 0.75% in one month and CPIAUCSL < 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1.5% mean) after a sharp FEDFUNDS cut and low inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in UNRATE above 5.5% for six consecutive months, regardless of GDP growth, indicates a structurally tight labor market that pressures profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1% mean) when UNRATE remains above 5.5% for six months.
